# Voxel Sandbox Placeholder Assets

These PNG textures are generated placeholder assets for the Infernux voxel
sandbox demo. They are intentionally original, simple, and CC0-compatible so
the repository can publish the demo without depending on Minecraft assets.

The demo was designed after checking public voxel/block-art sources that can
be used for later visual upgrades:

- Kenney Voxel Pack, CC0: https://opengameart.org/content/voxel-pack
- 16x16 Block Textures, CC0: https://opengameart.org/content/1616-block-textures
- 16x16 Block Texture Set, CC0: https://opengameart.org/content/16x16-block-texture-set

Current local files:

- `grass.png`
- `dirt.png`
- `stone.png`
- `wood.png`
- `leaf.png`
- `water.png`
